title: Phase Resolved Functional Lung MRI and Oscillometry for the Observation of Healthy Lung Function
official: Phase Resolved Functional Lung MRI and Oscillometry for the Observation of Healthy Lung Function
summary: This study will examine the relationship of airways resistance measured by oscillometry with ventilation defects measured by Phase Resolved Functional Lung (PREFUL) MRI in healthy human subjects.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Ability to provide consent
* Willingness to perform MRI and breathing test
* Must be able to speak and understand English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Unable or willing to provide consent or perform the required maneuvers for testing.
